description: Add a script-scoped verified prop alias resolver to the two-phase parser while keeping the exact current-shot source fragment authoritative and all non-prop facts strict.
steps: In E:/MJ/ai_film_editor_nodes/nodes/director/script_full_parser_node.py, extend the existing fact-evidence path around _fact_is_supported and _fact_validation_errors with a deterministic registry built only from verified context/global declarations in the supplied scene map/source manifest; do not derive evidence from sibling shot units.

Validate exact current-shot evidence first, then allow only a current-fragment short prop such as 佛珠 or 金链 to resolve to a detailed declaration from the same script; canonicalize accepted prop values to 深棕色小叶紫檀佛珠 and 2厘米宽实心粗金链 while retaining source_text/source_shot_text, source_unit_ids, offsets, block and occurrence unchanged.

Apply the scoped resolution to Phase 1 and Phase 2 props and prop interactions only, pass the approved catalog to the current Phase 2 prompt without sibling shot bodies, and preserve source-validation rejection for undefined props and unsupported actions, expressions, locations, lighting, dialogue, and camera facts.
acceptance_criteria: The shot_002 current fragment can use 佛珠 and 金链 while the same screenplay's verified global declarations canonicalize them to 深棕色小叶紫檀佛珠 and 2厘米宽实心粗金链.
source_text and source_shot_text remain the verbatim current-shot fragment and source-unit/block/occurrence binding is unchanged.
A prop absent from both the current exact fragment and the verified same-script context, or an unsupported non-prop fact, remains unverified and cannot be published.
Phase 2 receives no sibling shot body or sibling prop facts.
findings: Current code validates every props_list item only against source_shot_text, while explicit batch context already carries global/context units. Existing exact source, source manifest, and sibling-isolation helpers must remain the boundaries.
